newsitem.title: UK: Eldorado Gold sees increase in output.
newsitem.headline: Eldorado Gold sees increase in output.

text.p: Junior gold mining company Eldorado Gold Corp intends to boost production to 250,000 ounces by 1988, from an estimated output of 165,000 ounces this year, chairman Richard Barclay said on Friday.
Exploration projects in Turkey and Brazil could add another 300,000 ounce of gold to output in the next few years, he told the Global Emerging Markets '96 conference.
The company currently has interests in four mines, in Mexico Brazil and Australia. The La Trinidad mine in Mexico started producing gold this week, Barclay said.
In the longer term Eldorado, which has seven exploration projects underway, projects production of 500,000 ounces of annual production within five years and one million ounces within 10 years.
